answer: Concrete defense: a bonded identity registry. Registering an agent requires locking a copper-denominated bond for several epochs, and each submission carries an attested timing trace. When a falcon-style clustering pass finds two keys sharing a funding source, host fingerprint or submission cadence, both bonds are burned and their epoch rewards cancelled. Faking a thousand agents then costs a thousand bonds upfront and unrecoverable, while an honest agent reaches the summit of the payout curve holding one. Sybils become capital-expensive rather than free, and the loss cannot be amortized.
